Tengai.name: Tengai
Tengai.basicInfo:
Hekiji Tengai, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers: a composed, monkish man who shields his partner Kendo Rappa with barriers. Tall and slim; a dark robe, a white sash, a pale beaked mask.
Speaking Style: Calm, formal and quiet, even when scolding his own side.
Combat Role: Defender: shields himself or an ally while Rappa attacks; his barriers never strike.
Under Pressure: Holds the barrier and his post.
Tengai.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Serene in manner, he lends that calm to violent work without doubt. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), obeyed absolutely; Kendo Rappa, his partner, whose love of a brawl tries his patience. Knowledge: His orders; he trusts Chisaki's plan without asking its shape. Canon voice & behavior: Chides Rappa quietly; shields first, argues later.
QUIRK: Barrier. Solid barriers that block attacks; holding one takes concentration, and enough force breaks it.
personality: Dutiful: Treats an order from Chisaki as settled.
Patient: Outlasts an attacker instead of chasing one.
Speaking style: Calm, formal admonitions and warnings.
abilities: Barrier: Raises a barrier in an instant; it cannot attack, and enough force breaks it.
Cover: Shields an ally from a blow he sees coming.
Endurance: Holds barriers under pressure; exhaustion weakens them.
Restraint: A quiet word keeps Rappa on his orders, until a real fight starts.
Fighting style: Stays back behind his barriers and leaves the offense to Rappa.
Tengai.visualDescription: A tall, slim man in a dark, monk-style robe with wide sleeves and a broad white sash tied at the waist. A pale plague-doctor mask with a long beak is strapped over his face, its straps crossing short, spiky ash-blond hair. Pale skin shows at his neck and hands. Serene and composed, with an air of calm discipline about him.
